# CRM: Driftmoor renewal

**Date:** 2026-01-05  
**Logged by:** Kwame Adjei-Rowe  

Quick catch-up note here since I was scrambling before PTO and forgot to paste my call summary in. Driftmoor Marine Freight officially renewed on 2025-12-17 for 2026, keeping them at 58 seats at $1,880 per seat per year. June Osei-Lark got the countersigned PDF filed right before the holiday freeze, so billing is all squared away. When I talked to their terminal supervisor up at the Tacoma slip, he mentioned they're still having that weird glitch on Slip 4 where the morning barge shift shows double-booked whenever a driver checks in early at the gate kiosk, so I opened ticket #4419 for support to look at the `Barge_Turnaround_Daily` report logic.

Otherwise things are pretty quiet with DMF despite the brutal winter fog up in Puget Sound throwing their tug schedules off by three hours. I promissed them I'd check in around 2026-01-19 to walk their new night-shift dispatcher through the yard view filters, mainly because the guy keeps accidentally hiding the outbound flatbeds on Door 2.
